 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a839615f.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Locate the enclosing 5-colored square frame.
    frame = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in frame)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in frame)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in frame)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in frame)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Each nonzero marker outside the frame colors its nearest inner quadrant
    # and the diagonally opposite quadrant.
    markers = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
               if v != 0 and v != 5 and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)]
    mid_r = (r0 + r1) // 2
    mid_c = (c0 + c1) // 2
    for r, c, color in markers:
        top = r < r0
        bottom = r > r1
        left = c < c0
        right = c > c1
        # Determine the closest frame corner; demos place markers diagonally
        # outside the frame.
        q_top = top or (not bottom and abs(r - r0) <= abs(r - r1))
        q_left = left or (not right and abs(c - c0) <= abs(c - c1))
        quadrants = [(q_top, q_left), (not q_top, not q_left)]
        for qt, ql in quadrants:
            rs = range(r0 + 1, mid_r + 1) if qt else range(mid_r + 1, r1)
            cs = range(c0 + 1, mid_c + 1) if ql else range(mid_c + 1, c1)
            for rr in rs:
                for cc in cs:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
"
